title: Menu & Products
subtitle: Manage catalog, categories, pricing, modifiers and availability per store.
deleteSafePrompt: It is marked unavailable and disappears from the POS and the customer menu. Orders already placed are not affected, and you can make it available again at any time.
readOnlyNotice: View only. Your role can see the catalog but cannot change it.
categoriesOwnerOnlyNotice: Categories are managed by the account owner.

states.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.
states.emptyBody: Add products so they can be sold at the POS and shown to guests.
states.emptyNoCategoriesBody: Start by creating a category, such as Burgers, Sides or Beverages. Products are always organized in categories.
states.emptyNoCategoriesStaff: No category has been created yet. The account owner creates categories before products can be added.
states.filteredEmptyBody: Try another category, availability or search term.
states.stale: The menu could not be refreshed, so what you see may be out of date.

errors.category_in_use: This category still has active products. Mark them unavailable or move them to another category before archiving it.
errors.category_required: This product needs an active category.
errors.category_exists: This category already exists (it may have just been created in another session). The menu has been refreshed.
errors.category_archived: This category is archived. Reactivate it in Manage Categories to use it again. The menu has been refreshed.
errors.category_not_archived: This category is already active. The menu has been refreshed.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to perform this action.
errors.permission_denied: Your role doesn't allow this action.
errors.location_forbidden: This product is sold in stores you don't manage.
errors.not_found: This item no longer exists. The menu has been refreshed.
errors.invalid_menu: Check the name: it is required and can have up to 160 characters.
errors.invalid_modifiers: Check the modifier groups: every option needs a name and a price of zero or more.
errors.duplicate_modifier_group: Two modifier groups are the same. Remove the duplicate and save again.
errors.duplicate_modifier_option: A modifier group repeats an option. Remove the duplicate and save again.
errors.org_suspended: This account is suspended. Changes to the menu are paused.
errors.subscription_inactive: The subscription is inactive. Reactivate it to change the menu.
errors.unknown: We couldn't complete this action. Please try again.

validation.categoryRequired: Choose an active category for this product.
validation.categoryArchivedExists: “{{name}}” is an archived category. Reactivate it instead of creating a new one.
validation.noActiveCategory: There is no active category yet. Create one before adding products.
validation.noStore: You have no active store to sell this product in.

empty.title: No products found
empty.body: Create your first product or try another search filter.

item.categoryArchivedHint: Assign an active category before making this product available again.
item.notInYourStores: Sold in stores you don't manage
item.ownerOnlyAllStores: Sold in every store: only the account owner can change it.
item.inactiveStore: Sold in a store that is not active. Activate the store to change this product.

form.subtitle: Products appear at the POS and in the customer menu while they are available.
form.name: Item Name
form.categoryArchivedNotice: The category of this product was archived. Choose an active category to save it.
form.invalidPrice: Enter a valid price, for example 12.50.
form.allLocationsHint: Available in all locations by default
form.groupName: Group Name (e.g. Size, Meat Temperature, Add-ons)
form.optionName: Option Name (e.g. Medium Rare, Extra Bacon, No Onions)

categoriesDialog.subtitle: Categories organize the POS and the customer menu. Archived categories are hidden and can be reactivated at any time.
categoriesDialog.inUseHint_one: {{count}} available product uses this category. Mark it unavailable or move it before archiving.
categoriesDialog.inUseHint_other: {{count}} available products use this category. Mark them unavailable or move them before archiving.

categoryForm.title: New Category
categoryForm.name: Category Name (e.g. Smash Burgers, Sides, Beverages)

archiveCategory.title: Archive “{{name}}”?
archiveCategory.body: The category is hidden from the POS and the customer menu. Its unavailable products are kept, and you can reactivate the category later.

previewModal.title: Live Menu Preview
previewModal.subtitle: Rendered exactly as seen on American digital ordering displays.
